OpenAI's new model explained: what's actually different

Faster, cheaper, and surprisingly good at reasoning — here's the breakdown.

Jabid Ali

Editor-in-Chief

Jul 18, 20265 min read1240

OpenAI dropped a new model this week, and the headline numbers are impressive. But what actually changed under the hood?

Speed and cost

The new model is roughly 2x faster on most prompts and costs about half as much per million tokens. For developers building on the API, that compounds quickly.

Reasoning

On standard reasoning benchmarks the gains are modest, but on agentic tasks — multi-step tool use, long-running workflows — the improvement is significant.

What it means

For most users, the day-to-day experience won't feel radically different. For developers, the cost/quality tradeoff just shifted meaningfully.
